token_invalid: The API token is not valid.

fingerprint_mismatch: The fingerprint you typed is not the one the node shows. Compare them again.

key_reused: This node's key was admitted before. Reinstall the host so that it makes a new key.
node_limit_reached: Four nodes is the most allowed. Remove one first.
address_refused: This address is not accepted. It may be wrong, or another node may hold it.
table_invalid: This change would make the pair table invalid, so it was not made.
node_state: The node's current state does not allow this.

node_in_table: This node is still in the latest pair table and cannot be removed. Try again once the pair change has reached every node.
second_peer: A node can be in one pair only.
global_pair_required: Until there is a global pair, the new pair must be made global.
pair_in_use: This is the global pair and Endpoints use it. Change the global pair first.
upstream_loop: This address is the address of one of the upstream servers and would make a loop.
qps_out_of_range: The queries a second are outside the allowed range.
domain_invalid: The domain or host is not valid.
transition_active: The domain transition has not ended. Do not change the domain until it does.

cert_key_mismatch: The private key does not match this certificate.
cert_not_public: This certificate is not from a public authority.
